notes: Endlessness pulls toward Infinite Runner, but that genre's boundary rule settles it: forward motion here is the player's own over discrete jumps and wallhops, so Obby & Platformer leads and Infinite Runner is only named second. Shape is course-tower on the Tower Obby preset, whose stacked wrapping platforms carry the P2; I dropped the preset's winner-zone because a climb that never ends has no payoff at the top, and rejected Infinite Runner's Endless Climber preset because its lane-free shape assumes automatic motion. Every option comes from something stated: respawn where you landed is checkpoint-respawn, the staircase that vanishes underfoot is obstacle-timing, kill bricks are hazard-kill, wallhops are obstacle-climb, and "all sorts" is read narrowly as ordinary jump obstacles rather than an excuse to add everything. Three things the pipeline should know: the endless build is repeating vertical segments of about 100 studs that generate above the player, which is Infinite Runner's modular-chunk discipline and has no option row in the leading genre; wallhops rely on undocumented Humanoid timing rather than the documented jump limits, so that spacing cannot be validated by P6 and must be treated as author-supplied; and the height record and leaderboard the author asked for are UI, with only in-world height progress available to layout.
